mapper.select: SELECT user_id, token, expires_at, created_at FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, token, expires_at, created_at FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (user_id, token, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET token = #{token}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
